one_month_reasoning: Q3 FY2027 (quarter ended 2026-10-31) should be reported inside the window, about 2026-11-18/19 (last year Q3 came 2025-11-19; date not yet announced). The company has beaten its own EPS guide by +13% to +62% three quarters running and my build has 5.19 vs Street 4.33 (whisper 4.55, 80% range 4.24-4.88), so a beat is likely; but the last two prints (Mar, Aug) still sold off on margin and the FY28 outlook, and the stock sits at a 52-week low after AT&T's 2027-28 capex cut (2026-10-21). Insider buying in Sep and an oversold tape argue for slight positive drift. I centre at +1% with a lognormal sigma of 16% (53% annual vol / 3.5 = 15%, plus an earnings-day jump of about 10% historically), close to neutral given that short-horizon calls are scored tightly.

downside.story: P10: carrier capex retrenchment spreads beyond AT&T (Verizon/Frontier integration slows, AT&T pushes unit pricing), NTM Communications backlog 12% below path, Communications margin -150bp from pricing and labor; data-center orders pause (BS share of a slower market -25%, margin -300bp to high-teens); P/E de-rates another 2.5 turns as the market prices peak FTTH.

base.story: Median: Q3 FY27 beats (EPS ~5.19 vs Street 4.33), FY28 revenue 8319 and FY29 9072 on +8%/+6% Communications backlog growth and Building Systems tracking a data-center market growing ~30% then ~20%; margins at the approved path; the stock re-rates only partly (13.2x NTM EPS vs 12.1x today, peers 18.65x).

upside.story: P90: BEAD construction and long-haul hyperscaler fiber ramp on schedule, wireless recapture lands, NTM backlog +7%, Communications margin +80bp on operating leverage; Building Systems keeps share in a market still growing 25%+; multiple recovers 2.5 turns toward the peer median.

sbc_treatment.note: Company adjusted EPS excludes only amortization; SBC (0.53% of revenue) is a cost in EBIT, so the share count changes only by buybacks net of vesting (-0.5% a year). Peers' consensus EPS also carries SBC as a cost for MTZ/PWR/PRIM/MYRG (adjusted EPS exclude amortization, not SBC).

reasoning: Started from the Kilian-approved quarterly driver set (five drivers; FY27 revenue 7,656, FY28 ~8,320 after my change, FY29 ~9,070) and the fact pack. Lane research (alternative/trade/alt-data) asked why DY fell 61% from its high with no company news in October. The most concrete signal: AT&T (20% of DY revenue) on 2026-10-21 cut 2027-28 capital investment to $22-23B a year, ~$1B below prior plans, while holding its >60M fiber-location target, and said savings go to working capital - DY hit new lows on 2026-10-20/21 (QuiverQuant). Read with Wireless Estimator's warning that fiber may follow wireless into lower unit pricing and Verizon's move to 90-day contractor terms, it says carrier fiber volume holds but contractor economics are at risk; I trimmed comms_ntm_backlog growth to +8%/+6% a year in FY28/FY29 (approved +10%/+7%), worth about -$6/share, and put pricing compression into the downside case and long-dated risks. Offsets from the same lane: DY was hiring 1,175 field roles in late September (JobzMall), BEAD is ~90% shovel-ready only in 2027 (Fiber Connect panel) with all grant agreements approved (Broadband Breakfast), RVA forecasts record FTTH deployment through 2030, and Census data-center construction ran at $96B SAAR in Sep 2026 (vs $50.7B a year earlier); ConstructConnect's smaller remaining 2026 start pipeline and Microsoft's capex trim on third-party capacity delays temper the Building Systems path, so I kept the approved share path and widened its downside. Insiders (CEO, two directors) bought in September. Guidance: three straight EPS beats of +13% to +62% vs midpoint; my Q3 FY27 EPS 5.19 is above the guide top (4.79), Street 4.33 and the whisper range 4.24-4.88. My FY28 EPS (~19.9 model) is ~5% above Zacks 18.98 and ~4% below StockAnalysis 20.77. Valuation: DY at 12.1x NTM consensus vs 18.65x for the four whole-company peers (MTZ, PWR, PRIM, MYRG; 4 Building Systems peers are segment-only); the k = 0.8 shrink gives 13.2x, and EV/EBITDA 8.6x as the cross-check at 0.3. Supplier finance treated as debt. Base $297 (+34%) mostly comes from earnings growth and a partial re-rating; downside $145 (backlog -12%, comms margin -150bp, data-center pause, -2.5 turns) is further from base than the upside $444, a fatter left tail that matches 53% realized volatility and concentration risk. Limits: X/Twitter, Reddit and Google Trends were not reachable or yielded no usable DY-specific signal; the Kalshi recession market page could not be read, so no prediction-market input; Twelve Data statistics were not available on this plan. No option data was used.

drivers.label: Building Systems revenue / US private data center construction put in place
drivers.source: Market: U.S. Census Bureau, Value of Private Construction Put in Place, SAAR, "Data center" column (https://www.census.gov/construction/c30/xlsx/privsatime.xlsx; September 2026 release CB26-176, 2026-11-02): Sep-26p $96,462M, Aug-26r $88,815M, Sep-25 $50,700M; CY2024 avg $34,718M, CY2025 $49,712M. Building Systems revenue: Q4 FY26 95.8 (Power Solutions from 2025-12-23), Q1 FY27 395.4, Q2 FY27 397.5 incl. National Technology Integrators ~22.9 (Q2 FY27 release text; closed 2026-07-02, 10-Q https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/67215/000006721526000043/dy-20260801.htm). Power Solutions alone: CY2024 revenue $736.8M (audited, 8-K/A Ex.99.1 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/67215/000119312526099470/d72789dex991.htm), 9M 2025 $752.1M (Ex.99.2), i.e. ~2.1% of the market in both periods. FY27 Building Systems guide raised $1.15-1.25B (Mar) -> $1.35-1.45B (May) -> $1.58-1.65B (Aug); electricians short, some projects turned away (Q2 FY27 call). Building Systems NTM backlog 1,108 / 1,021 / 1,110 (Q4 FY26-Q2 FY27).
drivers.derivation: Q3 FY27 435 (2.0x the Q2 NTI month at ~23 plus Power Solutions near its H1 run-rate; guide-implied H2 ~822 = ~411 a quarter, record of three raises) = 1.85% of a 23,478 market; Q4 FY27 420 = 1.73% of 24,235. FY28-29 share falls 5% a year (-1.27% a quarter) from Q4 FY27: Power Solutions grew ~0.8x the market in CY2025 (share 2.12% -> ~2.0%) and FY27 share fell ~10% as the market jumped; labor caps the build. Gives Building Systems +6.8% FY28 (NTI full year adds ~+7%) and +15% FY29. Variant: share flat from Q4 FY27 = FY28 1,818 / FY29 2,199; share -10% a year = FY28 ~1,710 / FY29 ~1,850.

downside.story: P10: carrier capex retrenchment spreads beyond AT&T (Verizon/Frontier integration slows, AT&T pushes unit pricing), NTM Communications backlog 12% below path, Communications margin -150bp from pricing and labor; data-center orders pause (BS share of a slower market -25%, margin -300bp to high-teens); P/E de-rates another 2.5 turns as the market prices peak FTTH.

upside.story: P90: BEAD construction and long-haul hyperscaler fiber ramp on schedule, wireless recapture lands, NTM backlog +7%, Communications margin +80bp on operating leverage; Building Systems keeps share in a market still growing 25%+; multiple recovers 2.5 turns toward the peer median.
